title: Serve the product at /, the old UI at /classic
request: The new frontend replaces the current web UI on the existing server; the old UI stays reachable until the new one covers what it does.
spec: / returns the built app, /classic returns the earlier UI, and the CSP allows only this app. Done when the serve tests pass.
plan: Move the earlier UI to /classic, keeping its files in static/.
Keep the CSP strict (default-src, script-src, style-src, font-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none').
Point the existing test that loaded the old UI at /classic and add a test that / serves the product and the CSP names no other host.

decisions.decision: The old UI moved to /classic instead of being removed.
decisions.why: It could still start research campaigns, which the new UI could not; removing it first would have removed a feature (done later in 8.3 after the owner decided).

decisions.decision: At first the CSP admitted Google Fonts and nothing else outside.
decisions.why: The design used Inter and JetBrains Mono from Google; self-hosting needed the owner's approval to download font files (done in 1.5).

change: server.py serves the built app at / and the earlier UI at /classic; the CSP stays strict; tests updated.

findings.defect: An existing research-map test checked the old UI at /, which now serves the product.
findings.scenario: test_page_loads_split_assets requested / and looked for the old map view's markup and its scripts; after the change / returned the product and the test failed.
findings.cause: The route moved; the test still named the old path.
findings.fix: The test reads /classic, where the old UI now lives.
findings.test: tests/test_research_map.py reads /classic; tests/test_web_build.py checks / and the CSP.

outcome: Done: / serves the product, /classic the earlier UI, under a strict CSP. /classic was removed later in 8.3.
lessons: Keep an old UI behind a new path until an inventory shows the new one covers it.
